description: Defines access permissions for a document or folder in TmDocumentManager{TMetadata}.

members.name: CanCopy
members.description: Whether the item can be copied.

members.name: CanCreateFolder
members.description: Whether the user can create sub-folders inside this folder.

members.name: CanDelete
members.description: Whether the item can be deleted.

members.name: CanDownload
members.description: Whether the item can be downloaded.

members.name: CanMove
members.description: Whether the item can be moved to another folder.

members.name: CanRead
members.description: Whether the item can be viewed.

members.name: CanRename
members.description: Whether the item can be renamed.

members.name: CanShare
members.description: Whether the item can be shared with others.

members.name: CanUpload
members.description: Whether the user can upload new files into this folder.

members.name: CanWrite
members.description: Whether the item can be modified (renamed, metadata edited).
